```yaml
name: Lint

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'challenges/**'
      - 'scripts/**'
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  python-lint:
    name: Python Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install Python linting tools
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install black==23.12.1 isort==5.12.0 flake8==6.1.0

      - name: Run black
        run: black --check .

      - name: Run isort
        run: isort --check-only .

      - name: Run flake8
        run: flake8 .

  cpp-lint:
    name: C++/CUDA Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install clang-format
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y clang-format-15

      - name: Run clang-format
        run: |
          files=$(git ls-files '*.cpp' '*.cu' '*.h' '*.hpp')
          if [ -n "$files" ]; then
            clang-format-15 --dry-run --Werror -style=file $files
          else
            echo "No C++/CUDA files to format."
          fi

  mojo-lint:
    name: Mojo Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Mojo
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install mojo-lang

      - name: Run Mojo syntax check
        run: |
          files=$(git ls-files '*.mojo')
          if [ -n "$files" ]; then
            mojo --check $files
          else
            echo "No Mojo files to check."
          fi
```
